description.stringValue: CLOSED.  PLEASE HELP US REMIND FATBIKERS, SNOWSHOERS AND WALKERS THAT THIS IS A SKI ONLY TRAIL IN THE WINTER. THIS TRAIL IS FOR SKIING ONLY AND REQUIRES A TRAIL PASS IN THE WINTER.  Please no snowshoeing, running, walking or cycling.  The McLeod Creek and Willow Creek trails across the highway are perfect for multi use activities and dog walking.  You must purchase AND display your pass while skiing at the Farm and all of our other trails except the dog loop.  Help keep this community resource open and available by encouraging everyone to ski smart and have a pass.

CLOSED.  Please take your skis off when you cross the road and watch for icy and thin patches especially near the road crossing.  Purchase and have your pass displayed.  Please no dog walking, running or cycling on the ski trail.

CLOSED. Access at your own risk. . Poor conditions with some signs of mud, shrubbery and pavement appearing so we'll give it an 0.25/10 on the wagging tail chart and a "who's the good dog?".  PLEASE clean up your dog poop and remove it from the trail area.  Great for walking and skiing and running your furry buddies.  This trail is provided in Winter for your pet exercise fun. This is the ONLY part of White Pine Nordic trails where pets are allowed.  No fee to ski this small loop, but the remaining 20km are a fee area including the the Farm.  Please purchase AND display your trail pass.  Looking for other locations to ski with your pet?  Give us a call at the shop and we can help.  NO cycling or fat biking.

Ski with awareness and caution.  No classic track set. Purchase and display your trail pass.  Please help us remind dog owners and walkers that this is a ski trail and a fee area.  Walking or running leaves dangerous post-holes that are difficult to groom out. Round Valley and Willow Creek are great dog and walking options!

Very good level and rolling beginner terrain with access to Armstrong and Farm at junctions. Be aware of hazards near the trees, the cart paths and the trailhead.  Please be mindful of the neighbors, use the coat rack for your layers and the garbage can for your trash.  Please no dogs, walking or snow biking on the ski trail. Round Valley and Willow Creek are great dog walking and cycling options and are close by.
